item.title: NMail is Neat
item.description: I’ve written a lot of longer blog posts lately, time to get back into the classic “Nate talks about the thing he just read about and finds neat.” So, without further ado, I just read about NMail (github) - and I think it’s neat. In fact, I think it’s actually one of the most interesting decentralized communication tools I’ve seen in a while. Email is still king Email is still the king of communication - according to Wikipedia, 50 million non-spam emails are sent every day.
